carbon.$description: Brand black. The dark theme's ground, the app icon, the reverse logo's field. Pair with paper.

graphite.$description: Raised black: dark cards, the proposal cover band, case-study data panels.

ash.$description: Warm grey for secondary marks on paper (4-tone illustration, chart gridline labels).

sand.$description: Warm neutral block: cover relief, chart secondary series on paper, imagery mats.

paper.$description: Brand off-white. The light theme's ground; ink sits on it at 16:1.

chalk.$description: Lightest paper: raised cards and inputs in the light theme.

vermilion.$description: The mark's ink — the three nuqtas of the logo, the signature rhombus, a full-stop nuqta, cover blocks. Graphic only (3:1+ on surface in both themes); never body text on paper — use nuqta for that.

surface.$description: Page background. Ink, ink-muted, ink-faint and nuqta text all read on it.

surface-raised.$description: Cards, inputs, menus, table rows at rest.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells: code blocks, table header, the sidebar ground, skeleton loaders. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

surface-inverse.$description: Inverted bands (a dark section on a light page, the tooltip). Text on it is ink-inverse.

line.$description: Hairlines: dividers, card and table borders. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

line-strong.$description: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons): 3:1+ on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

ink.$description: Primary text and icons, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (14:1+ in both themes).

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, metadata, table headers — on any surface (5.6:1+).

ink-faint.$description: Placeholders and disabled labels, on surface and surface-raised only (4.8:1+).

ink-inverse.$description: Text and icons on surface-inverse and on carbon/paper bands.

nuqta.$description: Interactive accent: the primary button fill, links, active tab and nav indicators, selected rows' marker. As text, on surface, surface-raised and nuqta-soft (4.6:1+).

nuqta-soft.$description: Tinted ground behind nuqta text: a selected row, an active nav item, a 'new' badge.

on-nuqta.$description: Label and icon colour on a nuqta fill (the primary button): 6:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

success.$description: Done, live, passing. A blue-teal, off the red–green axis so it never relies on hue against danger. As text on surface or success-soft; always with a check icon or word.

success-soft.$description: Ground for success badges and banners.

warning.$description: Needs attention, not broken. Text on surface or warning-soft; always with the alert icon.

warning-soft.$description: Ground for warning badges and banners.

danger.$description: Errors and destructive actions. A crimson-rose kept apart from the brand vermilion: never use nuqta or vermilion to mean error. Text on surface or danger-soft; always with an icon or word.

danger-soft.$description: Ground for error banners, invalid-field hints, destructive confirmations.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring colour (2px, 2px offset): ink on every surface, so focus never reads as the accent or as an error.

link.$description: Inline links — an alias of nuqta, underlined 1px at rest.

space-2.$description: Inside compact controls; between a label and its field.

space-3.$description: Button inline padding (sm); list row gaps.

space-4.$description: Card padding (compact), form field gaps, the mobile page gutter.

space-8.$description: Between groups inside a section; the desktop gutter.

space-12.$description: Between sections inside a product page.

space-32.$description: Hero breathing room; proposal cover margins.

radius-0.$description: Marketing blocks, images, the cover band, tables.

radius-lg.$description: Mobile sheets and large mobile cards only.

radius-full.$description: Avatars and the switch track. Nothing else is round.

display-xl.$description: One per page: the website hero, the proposal cover, the case-study title.

display-lg.$description: Section openers on marketing pages; slide titles.

display-md.$description: Case-study chapter titles, social posts, pull quotes.

heading-1.$description: Page title inside products; document H1.

heading-3.$description: Card titles, table titles, form groups.

body-lg.$description: Marketing lead paragraphs, case-study body, proposals.

body-sm.$description: Hints, table cells in dense views, captions.

label.$description: Form labels, buttons, tabs, nav items.

ar-display.$description: Arabic hero and cover lines; pairs with display-xl/lg.

ar-body.$description: Arabic UI and reading text (one pixel larger than Latin body).

eyebrow.$description: Uppercase kicker above headings, section indices (01, 02…), slide footers.

duration-press.$description: The press: button active state, the nuqta stamp's compress.

duration-quick.$description: Hover, tab indicator move, tooltip in.

duration-trace.$description: The trace: a line drawing, a panel forming, a toast leaving its mark.

duration-reveal.$description: Marketing reveals only; never in product UI.
